notes: puremagic.from_string(bytes, mime=True), no file name. Recorded as not passing: it names a plain zip as an OOXML document, ID3v2.3 as audio/vnd.audiokoz, and does not know WebAssembly.
details: from_string(data, mime=True) returns the highest-confidence match and raises PureError when nothing matches; the adapter maps that exception to None, as the other entries return no type. Without a file name, puremagic ranks the OOXML signatures (docx, pptx, xlsx) first for every zip, 'ID3' + 3.0 matches audio/vnd.audiokoz (0.7) above audio/mpeg (0.5), and there is no WebAssembly signature. 10 of 56 fixtures fail (4 wasm, 2 mp3, 4 zip). The other 9 formats are right (bmp as image/x-ms-bmp).
